allocation.common_base: Round-robin over target relation and semantic ID after sorting rows by relation, semantic ID, source_group_id, and permutation_index.
allocation.common_base_exclusions: All 40 V3 target semantic IDs and all 80 selected V4 target semantic IDs.

arm_assignment.mapping: Bit 0 exposes member 0 in A and member 1 in B; bit 1 reverses the mapping.
requirements: exactly one member per pair exposed in each arm
A and B exposure is complementary
A and B label counts are identical
common-base prefix is byte-identical in every run

required: all 80 selected targets have at least 45 complete source groups
V3 and V4 target semantic IDs are disjoint
each block has exactly 8000 evaluation and 2560 exposure rows
evaluation and exposure source groups are disjoint within target
common base has exactly 22720 rows and excludes every V3/V4 target
all 32 training manifests have exactly 24000 rows
all A/B exposures are complementary with identical labels
all allocated rows fit the fixed length 185

source_group_selection.evaluation: Sort complete groups by source_group_id; use all six permutations from groups 0 through 32 and the first two permutations from group 33.
source_group_selection.exposure: Use all six permutations from complete groups 34 through 43 and the first four permutations from group 44.
